source_scope: Union of actual CI syntax inventory and selected suite fingerprints. Only the selected suite families are execution/real-media coverage; hashes of other retained tests establish syntax-source binding, not execution of their cases.
equivalence_policy: Independent Git object SHA1 and raw SHA256 verify each reviewed blob. Strict UTF8 roundtrip preserves literal BOM bytes; only LF versus CRLF checkout variants are accepted. Report actual tested commits stay unchanged. Source before/after equality is verified where arrays exist; setup single verified fields stay single. No arbitrary whitespace, BOM removal or relabeling of failed/preliminary evidence.
